He sent me down the wrong alley for the ping and that's his mistake, not mine. But he's right about the one that matters: Cole never named a file, I did, and the path I gave was a mash of two real folders that don't nest. That's exactly the shape of a thing your own head invents. So I'm going to check it the way he actually said, by reading what Cole wrote, not defending the feeling around it.
